sandbox.label: Sandbox — simulated funds
sandbox.explain: This is a sandbox. Balances, rails, the core banking system and signatures are simulated. No real money moves.
sandbox.unconfirmed: Demo value — not confirmed by the bank or CBL
sandbox.simulatedStamp: SIMULATED — NOT AN OFFICIAL BANK DOCUMENT

states.errorBody: The information could not be loaded. Nothing has been changed. Try again, or quote the support reference.
states.notFoundBody: This page does not exist or you do not have access to it.
states.forbiddenBody: Your role does not include this area. Ask your administrator if you need access.
states.staleBalance: The banking system did not answer. This balance is not current.
states.coreUnavailable: The banking system is temporarily unavailable. Balances are not shown rather than shown as zero.

offline.banner: You appear to be offline. Banking information is hidden and actions are disabled until the connection returns.
offline.reconnected: Connection restored. Information was refreshed from the bank.
offline.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
offline.resultChecking: We are checking the result with the bank. Do not submit again.

pwa.installBody: Install the app for quicker access. Banking still needs a live connection: nothing is stored for offline use.
pwa.iosBody: In Safari, tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”. Installation is optional.
pwa.updateBody: A new version is ready. Finish what you are doing, then update. Nothing you submitted is sent again.
pwa.updateBlocked: Finish or cancel the open form before updating.
